sentences.en: A budget deficit will occur because of a revenue shortfall.
sentences.zh: 由于收入不足，会出现预算赤字。

sentences.en: Eliminating the deficit will be a hard nut to crack.
sentences.zh: 消除赤字将会是一项艰巨的任务。

sentences.en: Americans accumulated their trade deficits by living far beyond their means.
sentences.zh: 美国人通过过度消费积累了贸易赤字。

senses.zh: 亏损，赤字，不足额；（体育用语）失分数；缺乏，缺陷
